action: death animation of a lizard that keeps facing the viewer the whole time, it never turns sideways: frame 1 it is struck and jerks its head back; frames 2 to 4 its legs give way and it falls down flat, the whole body and head dropping onto the ground, rolling over onto its side, legs sticking out limp and curled, tail lying flat on the ground, jaw hanging open, eye shut; frames 5 to 8 it lies dead and completely still on the ground as a corpse, flat and low, the last frames identical. It does not crouch, does not walk, does not get up. Stays in the same place. No blood, no liquid, no splatter, no particles, no shadow
